changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0062. Optional personal-training sessions included with a membership, plus a separate personal-training package catalog and assignment. Index review: no new index on MembershipPlans or GymMemberships because the added counts are read with the existing plan and membership rows. PK on PtPackages and MemberPtAssignments. UX_PtPackages_TenantId_Name keeps catalog names unique per tenant. IX_PtPackages_TenantId_IsActive serves the active package picker. UX_MemberPtAssignments_Open stops a second active assignment of the same package to the same member. IX_MemberPtAssignments_MemberProfileId reads a member's package assignments. Performance note: package lists and assignment checks stay tenant-scoped and seek one member.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.MembershipPlans ADD IncludedPtSessions INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MembershipPlans_IncludedPtSessions DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE app.MembershipPlans ADD CONSTRAINT CK_MembershipPlans_IncludedPtSessions CHECK (IncludedPtSessions >= 0);
ALTER TABLE app.GymMemberships ADD IncludedPtSessions INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_GymMemberships_IncludedPtSessions DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE app.GymMemberships ADD CONSTRAINT CK_GymMemberships_IncludedPtSessions CHECK (IncludedPtSessions >= 0);

CREATE TABLE app.PtPackages ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Name NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, Description NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, SessionCount INT NOT NULL, ValidityDays INT NOT NULL, Price DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL, Currency NVARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_PtPackages PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PtPackages_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_PtPackages_SessionCount CHECK (SessionCount > 0), CONSTRAINT CK_PtPackages_ValidityDays CHECK (ValidityDays > 0), CONSTRAINT CK_PtPackages_Price CHECK (Price >= 0) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PtPackages_TenantId_Name ON app.PtPackages (TenantId, Name) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_PtPackages_TenantId_IsActive ON app.PtPackages (TenantId, IsActive) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE app.MemberPtAssignments ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MemberProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, PtPackageId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TrainerProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, StartDate DATE NOT NULL, EndDate DATE NOT NULL, SessionCount INT NOT NULL, SessionsRemaining INT NOT NULL, Price DECIMAL(19, 4) NOT NULL, Currency NVARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, PaymentStatus NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_MemberPtAssignments PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtAssignments_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtAssignments_MemberProfiles FOREIGN KEY (MemberProfileId) REFERENCES app.MemberProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtAssignments_PtPackages FOREIGN KEY (PtPackageId) REFERENCES app.PtPackages (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberPtAssignments_TrainerProfiles FOREIGN KEY (TrainerProfileId) REFERENCES app.TrainerProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtAssignments_Dates CHECK (EndDate >= StartDate), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtAssignments_Sessions CHECK (SessionCount > 0 AND SessionsRemaining >= 0 AND SessionsRemaining <= SessionCount), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtAssignments_PaymentStatus CHECK (PaymentStatus = N'Unpaid'), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberPtAssignments_Status CHECK (Status = N'Active') ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_MemberPtAssignments_Open ON app.MemberPtAssignments (MemberProfileId, PtPackageId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL AND Status = N'Active'; CREATE INDEX IX_MemberPtAssignments_MemberProfileId ON app.MemberPtAssignments (TenantId, MemberProfileId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
